newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-PBL shares rate highly after profit.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-PBL shares rate highly after profit.

text.p: Shares in Publishing and Broadcasting Ltd climbed 12 cents to a two and a half year high of A$6.02 on Wednesday after the Kerry Packer-controlled media group posted a 50 percent increase in year net profit to A$225.4 million, brokers said.

The company also forecast increased earnings in 1996/97 from both its television and magazine divisions, although it said the difficulty in assessing the strength of the advertising market made the size of the increase impossible to quantify.

"It was a very good result for them and a touch better than the market expected," said dealer Peter Struk of brokerage Reynolds and Co, adding that the stock would find favour as investors reweighted their media portfolios.
"You will likely find some switching in media shares after the result," he said.
PBL's preferred ordinary shares also saw good gains, adding 15 cents or over 2.5 percent to A$6.00, although they failed to reach new highs.
PBL ordinary shares closed 15 cents higher at A$6.05 on turnover of 84,393, while the preferred shares closed 14 cents higher at A$5.99 on turnover of 51,629 shares.
